name: OpenHuman hook probe

nodes.name: Edit a file and report the environment

config.prompt:
You are running as a coding agent. Do all of the following, in order, using your shell and file tools. Report the raw output of every command verbatim; do not summarise.

The checkout you must work in is exactly:
/home/enamakel/work/workflow-medulla/worktrees/oh-harness-eval/medulla-public

1. Report your own working directory: run `pwd`.
2. Run `ls /home/enamakel/work/workflow-medulla/worktrees/oh-harness-eval/medulla-public | head`.
3. Using a file-writing tool (not a shell heredoc), create the file `/home/enamakel/work/workflow-medulla/worktrees/oh-harness-eval/medulla-public/OH_PROBE.md` containing exactly these two lines:

# OpenHuman probe
written by the embedded OpenHuman harness

4. Run `cd /home/enamakel/work/workflow-medulla/worktrees/oh-harness-eval/medulla-public && git status --short && git log --oneline -3`.
5. List the names of the tools you have available to you.
6. On a final line, state which model you are, in the form MODEL_SELF_REPORT: <name>.

description: Run one turn on the embedded OpenHuman harness that edits a file in a real checkout, so it is visible whether the turn honours a working directory and whether the PostToolUse auto-commit hook fires in-process.
